title: Parmesan Brussels Sprouts
description: These Parmesan Brussels sprouts are cooked in garlic butter until golden brown and finished with a sprinkle of cheese for a flavorful holiday side.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons shredded Parmesan cheese, or more to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Heat a frying pan over medium heat until hot, 3 minutes. Melt 1 tablespoon butter; cook and stir garlic until fragrant, 30 seconds. Add 1 tablespoon butter and Brussels sprouts, cut-side down; cover and cook until golden brown, 4 to 6 minutes.
Flip Brussels sprouts and add remaining 1 tablespoon butter. Cover and cook until other side is browned, about 3 more minutes.
Transfer Brussels sprouts to a serving plate. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, salt, and black pepper.

video.description: This classic preparation for Brussels sprouts will no doubt please you if you are already a sprouts lover, and if you’re not, it’s sure to win you over. Preparation couldn’t be simpler—Melt butter in your frying pan, then cook up some garlic until fragrant and add trimmed and halved sprouts. Once you’ve given them a good browning, serve with shredded Parmesan and season with salt and pepper. Be careful, though . . . these caramelized veggies are quite delicious and addictive!
